terms.title: Terms
terms.description: An explicitly requested weighted average of named component effects. Nonnegative fixed weights sum to one; no empirical reweighting.

question.title: Question
question.description: The finalized user-request text used to launch the analysis. This is the only launch-question source.

assumptions.title: Assumptions
assumptions.description: References to existing conditional, qualified or interpreted context statements. These do not supply missing essential meanings.

optional_unknowns.title: Optional Unknowns
optional_unknowns.description: Focused unresolved optional questions, not asserted facts. Unknown optional scientific roles do not block preparation.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Temporal/factor structure, not identification or randomization. point means one factor at one occasion, including threshold assignment and fuzzy/noncompliant receipt. joint means a declared process assigning several factors together. Neither implies randomization or perfect compliance. absorbing_adoption means treatment starts and remains on; switching or dynamic_regime require unsupported regime capabilities. Use unknown only when this structure is unresolved.

id.title: Id
id.description: Bare ledger identity, e.g. no_interference. References use assumption:no_interference.

source_keys.title: Source Keys
source_keys.description: Exact statement keys in the applied context. Drafts may use edit:<zero-based index> for an add/replace in this same proposal. No copied or invented factual claim.

question.title: Question
question.description: The finalized user-request text used to launch the analysis. This is the only launch-question source.

assumptions.title: Assumptions
assumptions.description: References to existing conditional, qualified or interpreted context statements. These do not supply missing essential meanings.

optional_unknowns.title: Optional Unknowns
optional_unknowns.description: Focused unresolved optional questions, not asserted facts. Unknown optional scientific roles do not block preparation.

id.title: Id
id.description: Stable identity for this intervention variable, not an arm or display-name inference.

prerequisites.title: Prerequisites
prerequisites.description: Accepted decisions used as dependencies, separate from direct evidence or assumption authority.

prerequisites.title: Prerequisites
prerequisites.description: Accepted decision references used as context or dependencies. These never supply factual or causal authority; references must still contain the required direct evidence or declared assumption.

conflicts_with.title: Conflicts With
conflicts_with.description: Explicitly declared conflicting statement keys. This records a reviewed conflict without inferring contradiction from prose.

key.title: Key
key.description: For add, use an existing COLLECTION key such as dataset.qualifications, columns.<exact-column-id>.definition, concepts or relationships. Never append an invented statement ID; the server assigns it. For every other action, select the exact existing full statement key including its ID.

unsupported.description: Faithful description of an unimplemented history, adaptive regime or nonlinear contrast. Preserve it and return unsupported, never replace it with a static contrast.

value_ids.title: Value Ids
value_ids.description: One exact value for every factor in this joint state. The list and signed weight are frozen, not empirical probabilities.

conflicts_with.title: Conflicts With
conflicts_with.description: Explicitly declared conflicting statement keys. This records a reviewed conflict without inferring contradiction from prose.

assignment_variable_id.title: Assignment Variable Id
assignment_variable_id.description: Exact observed variable carrying treated/control codes, distinct from a selected cohort regime when appropriate. Required for fresh diagnostic windows, never inferred from a name or selected factor.

cutoff_in.title: Cutoff In
cutoff_in.description: Which side contains equality: above means >= cutoff; below means <= cutoff.

estimand.title: Estimand
estimand.description: local_wald is the outcome jump divided by the receipt jump in the same direction. These computational components are not additional requested effects.

treatment_value_ids.title: Treatment Value Ids
treatment_value_ids.description: Ordered [control, treated] levels on the selected factor. For fuzzy receipt these levels do not assert deterministic receipt at the cutoff.

assignment_value_ids.title: Assignment Value Ids
assignment_value_ids.description: Optional ordered [ineligible, eligible] levels on a distinct observed eligibility variable. Empty means eligibility is defined by the explicit threshold rule, not an observed assignment column.

conflicts_with.title: Conflicts With
conflicts_with.description: Exact conflict statement keys or edit:<index> in this save. Omitted on replacement preserves existing conflicts; explicit [] records reviewed resolution.

EditStatement.title: EditStatement
EditStatement.description: Semantic inputs only. Identity, authorship and status are server assigned.

adjustment.title: Adjustment
adjustment.description: Identifying causal adjustment only. Copy exactly the accepted identification's adjustment set. Estimator regressors such as an RD running score, and operational unit/time keys, belong in the estimator specification and are not additional identifying adjustment variables.

result_kind.title: Result Kind
result_kind.description: Use estimate for an ordinary point estimate with its confidence interval, including t/Welch, normal, robust or bootstrap intervals. Use confidence_set only for a prespecified nonstandard set-valued procedure that can produce an empty, disconnected or unbounded region, such as test inversion under weak identification; an ordinary confidence interval does not require it. Use estimate_without_inference for a prespecified justified point-only result, and structural_zero only for an exactly zero effect established by the accepted causal graph.

comparison.description: Historical records may omit this. Fresh analyses freeze a typed comparison separately from the factor and assignment process; exactly the payload named by kind is present.

comparison_value_ids.title: Comparison Value Ids
comparison_value_ids.description: Exact comparison cohorts on the same cohort variable, including an explicitly coded never-treated cohort where requested. No inferred not-yet-treated selection.

adoption_period.description: Explicit adoption time on time_variable_id's numeric scale. Never infer it from the cohort label or numeric cohort code.

strategy.title: Strategy
strategy.description: aggregate is deterministic closure of the exact frozen weighted component effects, permitted only for a typed aggregate comparison. It adds no adjustment or new identification premises.

obligations.title: Obligations
obligations.description: Named identification obligations: did requires parallel_trends, no_anticipation, comparison_support; discontinuity requires cutoff_rule and continuity or local_randomization. Graph checks are conditional on the accepted causal account.

conflicts_with.title: Conflicts With
conflicts_with.description: Explicitly declared conflicting statement keys. This records a reviewed conflict without inferring contradiction from prose.

analysis_references.title: Analysis References
analysis_references.description: Exact references from supplied analysis_references, separate from context-pack keys. These bind saved analysis decisions or numerical evidence to this turn.

analysis_brief.description: An unsaved proposed analysis brief. Only explicit Apply changes writes it atomically with context_edits. Supporting fields select exact context statement keys or edit:<index>; never copy factual claims or set readiness.

source.title: Source
source.description: Exact key from numeric_evidence supporting this specific numerical statement.

value.title: Value
value.description: The number exactly as written in the reply, including rounding.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Scientific roles relative to the requested effects. irrelevant means no applicable scientific role, not merely excluded from the adjustment set. A pre_outcome, confounder, modifier or other scientific role still requires explicit scope even when also marked irrelevant or not adjusted for.

outcome_proxy.title: Outcome Proxy
outcome_proxy.description: Harness-owned lineage classification. Return null; the harness derives it from sourced lineage and accepted timing.

effect_ids.title: Effect Ids
effect_ids.description: Exact requested effects to which this role applies. Required for every scientific role or operational use, including relevant variables intentionally excluded from adjustment.

treatment_ids.title: Treatment Ids
treatment_ids.description: Exact accepted treatment identities whose events define this role and timing. Required for every scientific role or operational use; irrelevant does not cancel another role's scope.

time_scope.title: Time Scope
time_scope.description: Explicit measurement/reference window relative to the selected treatment_ids. Required for scientific roles and operational uses. A timing label alone does not identify the measurement window; irrelevant does not mean merely unadjusted.

assignment_event_key.title: Assignment Event Key
assignment_event_key.description: Harness-owned canonical assignment-event identity for this role receipt. Models do not author this field; historical records may omit it.

status.title: Status
status.description: Provider invocation state. Accepted means a typed proposal was received, not that a scientific gate accepted it.

status.title: Status
status.description: Provider invocation state. Accepted means a typed proposal was received, not that a scientific gate accepted it.

conflicts_with.title: Conflicts With
conflicts_with.description: Explicitly declared conflicting statement keys. This records a reviewed conflict without inferring contradiction from prose.

terms.title: Terms
terms.description: Ordered signed linear contrast over explicit complete states. Weights sum to zero. Averaging over another factor requires its explicit states and declared weights, never inferred independence.

requested_effects.title: Requested Effects
requested_effects.description: The effects requested by the supplied question, each with its stable identity and priority. Freeze these before binding treatment variables. Auxiliary computations such as a ratio's numerator or denominator are not additional effects unless separately requested as effects.

assignment.description: Historical per-factor account. New analyses describe assignment once in assignments[].

id.title: Id
id.description: Proposal-local value identity. The harness binds it canonically to variable_id and the typed literal.

variable_id.title: Variable Id
variable_id.description: Exact selected factor or offered cohort/eligibility variable. Metadata variables remain separate from intervention factors.

treatments.title: Treatments
treatments.description: Intervention variables/factors, NOT treatment arms or levels. One binary or categorical column is one Treatment. Its values belong in values[] and the requested comparisons in effects[].comparison.

values.title: Values
values.description: Source-qualified typed value registry shared across comparisons. Contains no inferred or data-discovered levels. Historical records may omit it.

literal.title: Literal
literal.description: Exact source representation. Text '1' differs from number '1'. Numbers must be finite decimal literals; booleans use true or false. Never discover levels from target outcomes.

derivation.title: Derivation
derivation.description: Empty for a directly observed column. Otherwise the exact transformation, not a description such as 'directly observed'.
